canonical_project: Hunnu City renewable-powered data center development
owner: Erdenes Mongol / Chinggis Khaan Sovereign Wealth Fund
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported Mongolia's sovereign wealth fund is looking to bring in data-center development and highlighted Hunnu, a 31,000-hectare project set up in 2024, as a smart-tech hub candidate using geothermal energy. Hunnu City sources place the development south of Ulaanbaatar near the new Chinggis Khaan International Airport; Mongolian government social posts identify Hunnu/New Zuunmod in Sergelen and Altanbulag sums of Tov aimag. No site-specific MW has been announced.
